title: Gene Expression Network and Circ_0008012 Promote Progression in MLL/AF4 Positive Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
authors: Tang, Yan-Lai; Su, Jia-Yin; Luo, Jie-Si; Zhang, Li-Dan; Zheng, Li-Min; Liang, Cong; Wang, Li-Na; Li, Yu; Fan, Zhong; Huang, Dan-Ping; Sun, Panpan; Luo, Zhenhua; Qi, Ning Hao; Lan, Jing-Jing; Zhang, Xiao-Li; Huang, Li-Bin; Luo, Xue-Qun
journal: Recent patents on anti-cancer drug discovery
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MLL/AF4阳性白血病中circ_0008012与IKKbeta的RNA-蛋白结合及NF-kappaB通路机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅涉及湿实验验证。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with MLL/AF4 rearrangement remains a major hurdle to improving outcomes. Gene network and circRNAs have been found to participate in tumorigenesis, while their roles in leukemia still need to be explored. Recent patents have shown that circRNAs exhibit the markers for the children ALL, although the target and related mechanism remain to be elucidated. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to explore the possible targets and mechanisms of ALL with MLLAF4 rearrangement. METHODS: We first generated a gene network focusing on MLL-AF4 rearrangement. Cell viability was determined with Cell Counting Kit-8 assay. The cell apoptosis was tested by the Annexin V/PI assay. The RNA-protein complexes were analyzed by qRT-PCR, and the pathway proteins were analyzed by western blot. RESULTS: This gene network was associated with biological processes, such as nucleic acid metabolism and immunity, indicating its key role in inflammation. We found that circ_0008012 was upregulated in MLL/AF4 ALL cells and regulated cell proliferation and apoptosis. Further computed simulation and RIP showed that IKKbeta was the strongest protein in the NF-kappaB pathway binding with circ_0008012. As a result, possible regulation of circ_0008012 is suggested by binding IKKbeta in the IKKalpha:IKKbeta:IKKgamma compound, which then phosphorylates IkappaB and activates NF- kappaB:p65:p300 compound in cell nucleus, thereby leading to leukemia. CONCLUSION: We identified a gene network for MLL/AF4 ALL. Moreover, circ_0008012 may be a therapeutic target for this subtype of ALL.
abstract_zh: 背景：伴有MLL/AF4重排的急性淋巴细胞白血病仍是改善预后的主要障碍。基因网络和circRNAs已被发现参与肿瘤发生，而它们在白血病中的作用仍需探索。近期专利显示，circRNAs在儿童ALL中表现出标志物特征，尽管其靶点及相关机制尚待阐明。目的：本研究旨在探索MLL/AF4重排ALL的可能靶点及机制。方法：我们首先构建了聚焦于MLL-AF4重排的基因网络。细胞活力通过Cell Counting Kit-8实验测定。细胞凋亡通过Annexin V/PI实验检测。RNA-蛋白质复合物通过qRT-PCR分析，通路蛋白通过western blot分析。结果：该基因网络与核酸代谢和免疫等生物过程相关，表明其在炎症中的关键作用。我们发现circ_0008012在MLL/AF4 ALL细胞中上调，并调控细胞增殖和凋亡。进一步的计算模拟和RIP显示，IKKbeta是与circ_0008012结合的NF-kappaB通路中最强的蛋白质。因此，circ_0008012可能通过结合IKKalpha:IKKbeta:IKKgamma复合物中的IKKbeta来发挥调控作用，该复合物随后磷酸化IkappaB并激活细胞核中的NF-kappaB:p65:p300复合物，从而导致白血病。结论：我们识别了MLL/AF4 ALL的基因网络。此外，circ_0008012可能是该亚型ALL的治疗靶点。
